title: Write Your First Skill
description: Ysil will teach you to write your first Claude Code skill — a recipe Claude can run from your terminal to build something for the village.

hudHints.objective: Write a skill at Ysil's recipe table, then use it to build something
hudHints.instruction: Talk to Ysil in the village square. Pick a buildable, name your skill, and choose when Claude should run it. After it's saved, press F anywhere in the village to use your skill.
hudHints.detail: Claude Code skills are markdown files in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with frontmatter (name, description, allowed-tools) and a body Claude follows. Your skill will read game-data/placement-intent.json (written when you press F), generate a sprite, and add an entry to game-data/buildings.json. The file watcher spawns it in the world.
hudHints.copyable: Talk to Ysil at her recipe table in the village square

npcReaction.speaker: Ysil
npcReaction.text: Look at that. Your skill ran, the building landed, the village answered. That's the whole loop.

_creatorNote.lesson: Skills are recipes Claude can run from the terminal. The hardest part isn't what the skill does — it's the description that tells Claude when to run it. The recipe table makes that explicit (too broad / just right / too specific) and gives the player a real, reusable skill that lands a sprite in the world.
_creatorNote.realWorldParallel: Creating a SKILL.md with well-chosen frontmatter (especially the description) and a body that performs a concrete, scoped task.
